text: CRITICAL! Wildfire spreading rapidly in Los Angeles hills. Dense smoke filling homes, urgent need for burn ointment, firefighter assistance, and shelter for 5 residents.

text: Category 4 hurricane storm surge flooded coastal homes in Miami FL. Power out, need evacuation boat, clean drinking water, food, and dry clothes for 8 victims.

Severe typhoon winds blown off roofs in San Juan Puerto Rico. 6 people injured by flying debris, need emergency medical team and tarps.
Industrial chemical warehouse fire in Houston TX. Toxic smoke plume, immediate firefighter team and oxygen masks needed!
Tropical cyclone storm warning issued for coastal Florida. Heavy rainfall and gale force winds expected overnight.

Hurricane evacuation center setting up in Tampa FL. Need 100 cots, warm blankets, and clean drinking water bottles.
Controlled burn management conducted by forestry department in Oregon. No public hazard.
SOS! Wildfire trapped 4 campers inside wooden cabin in Northern California. Heavy smoke, fire trucks and rescue chopper needed immediately!

Residential kitchen fire contained by local fire department with no injuries reported.
